designationHistory.indexText: Cameron Prairie National Wildlife Refuge in southwest Louisiana was established by the Fish and Wildlife Service.
designationHistory.note: FWS only, and the CCP is inconsistent: its 'Date Established' entry gives December 29, 1988, while the narrative refers to the refuge being established in 1989. Authority not extracted.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Cameron Prairie NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2006 (ServCat 168187)
